title: Smartcard — Dependants Pass
preface: This test is to confirm a Dependants Pass smartcard is recognised at the point of sale and applies the dependants-pass entitlement to the fare.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on and selling a fare in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** a Dependants Pass entitlement smartcard is available (a Corporate card — FBD-100250)
**AND** example: selling a NIR Adult Single, the dependants-pass entitlement is applied on presenting the card

steps.content: **WHEN** the operator presents the Dependants Pass smartcard
steps.expected:
**THEN** the card is recognised
**AND** the dependants-pass entitlement is applied to the fare

steps.content: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.expected: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

steps.content: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
**WHEN** the smartcard record is reviewed in SmartTrack
steps.expected: **THEN** the updated smartcard record appears in SmartTrack

change_note: Corrected spelling 'Dependents' -> 'Dependants' throughout (title, preface, preconditions, step) — FBD-100250's Corporate card taxonomy spells it 'Dependants', and the sibling case 4102565 ('Faulty — Dependants Pass Receipt') in the same batch already uses the correct spelling. Naming-consistency fix, not a behavioural change.

Added citation — refs was null. Offline single-use validation being queued on-device and synced back to Corethree on reconnect (to guard against reuse) is exactly the behaviour specified in FBD-100317.

preconds:
**GIVEN** a POS is signed off with no ticket transactions
**AND** every device performs a Staff List Refresh check every 15 minutes regardless of state (FBD-100266 para 148)

change_note: Tightened citation to the specific paragraphs and added an UNCONFIRMED marker: the spec itself (V3.00) presents the StaffList-reuse heartbeat as a proposed solution pending demonstration, not an asserted-shipped behaviour — per the no-gap-filling rule this must be marked unconfirmed rather than asserted outright, even though the CR is old enough it may since have shipped.
gaps: Whether FBD-100266's Method 2 (Staff List Refresh reused for heartbeat; Hours Since Last Communication reset to zero on a StaffList message) is actually live on the current CloudFare build is not confirmed anywhere in the cited note — raise as gap-register Q25.
